description: Set the public note status pages show for an incident, e.g. what is wrong and when a fix is expected. It is published at once to every status page that shows the check, so agree the wording with the user first. An empty note removes it.

dry_run.description: Preview the action without executing it. Returns what would happen, including cost estimates. Always dry-run first for anything that costs money.

note.description: The note, up to 2,000 characters. Empty removes it.

name: edge_set_pulse_incident_note
